additional_info.subject: SG-SiD: EV Compataibility with MG ZS
additional_info.body:
Dear Helpdesk,
Country: Singapore
Charger ID: nNWYn2
Charger Serial No: MP / R4 170001840
Vehicle : MG ZS
Issue Date and Time: 2024-08-20 UTC 04:15:18 to 05:09 (There is only 1 vehicle MG ZS on site and we were testing on both DC1 and DC2)
Problem statement: We are unable to initate charging using this process flow of Plug In vehicle and then Authenticate the RemoteStartTransaction via OCPP. The charger always indicate a fault when the vehicle is plug in first before authentication and we will require to unplug to re-initate the charging session.
Upon checking the SiD logs, we had found this. It is unusual as there is no charging being intiated yet.
nNWYn2           1724127319273            2024-08-20T04:15:18.974589+00:00 swcpu [user:debug] [ONR]  DC2 : Outlet not ready - output voltage is too high to begin charging         1724127324368          38449324036932829457698537644531889465651219015698087941
It is also logged that the reverse voltage is detect, but it will be self corrected by the vehicle.
nNWYn2           1724129012309            2024-08-20T04:43:30.546687+00:00 swcpu [user:debug] IMD: DC connection with wrong polarity:  "DC1"    1724129015687          38449361792897277397190620742277172559805242664738291713
nNWYn2           1724129013311 2024-08-20T04:43:32.085864+00:00 swcpu [user:debug] Cablecheck: Testvoltage reached:  "DC1"    1724129015687           38449361815242624086118305130095962268998900893730668546
nNWYn2           1724129017325            2024-08-20T04:43:33.090751+00:00 swcpu [user:debug] IMD: DC connection established:  "DC1"        1724129023162          38449361904757815313020226429256784918910572000700203008
Therefore, we would like to understand instead of identifying as a fault, to allow for more buffer timing for vehicle to react to the initiation of the charging session, for the vehicle to correct itself on the revser voltage.
With best regards,
Edna Seah
Siemens Pte Ltd
RC-SG SI E
60 MacPherson Road
348615 Singapore, Singapore
Mobile: +65 9816 9400
mailto:edna.seah@siemens.com
